doc: Custom asset manifest. Edit by hand or with `forge assets ...`; `forge assets sync` writes game/ReplicatedStorage/Config/AssetIds.luau from it. See docs/game/07-assets.md.

assets.prompt: cartoon red fire helmet with gold badge, low poly
assets.notes: 02 §5 helmet (HelmetRed #C0301E, gold shield). Trial generation 2026-10-23 in the Firefighter Mubit place; the Studio copy was deleted, ids kept. Number decal (01-04) still goes on top as a SurfaceGui.

assets.notes: 02 §5. v1 is part-built (pupils must jiggle); use the mesh only for the eye-white shells.

assets.notes: 02 §9 viewmodel glove (GloveOlive #8C7A3A). Always on screen, so worth the quota.

assets.notes: 02 §13 v2 hero truck via generate_procedural_model (50/day quota). Needs the 67 SurfaceGui on top. If no publishedAssetId comes back, save it as a package by hand.

assets.prompt: burnt charred black wood with glowing ember cracks, cartoon

02 §7 smoke sheet. Fallback: rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds.
